services.name: San Juan Regional Medical Center EMS
services.area: San Juan County EMS area (everything outside the Navajo Nation boundary; its ALS ambulances also run county-wide)
services.evidence: "providing both Advanced Life Support (ALS) and Basic Life Support (BLS) ambulance services in cooperation with San Juan County and the cities of Farmington, Aztec and Bloomfield 24 hours a day ... If you need emergency ambulance transport, call 911. ... Our ALS ambulances are stationed throughout San Juan County and cover 5,500 square miles." | NM 911 Program (DFA) EMS boundary layer assigns San Juan County EMS area (everything outside the Navajo Nation boundary; its ALS ambulances also run county-wide) to Agency_ID "ems.co-sanjuan.911-sanjuan.nm.us" (57% of the county). NM DOH EMS Bureau list, provided by the EMS Bureau 2026-10-21: combined ambulance list 2024 "SAN JUAN REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER, INC DBA SAN JUAN REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER AMBULANCE SERVICE ... AMBULANCE ... CERTIFIED"; 2025 list "San Juan Regional EMS | DOT Service | ALS".
services.vintage: page undated, opened 2026-10-22; Bureau 2026-06-18 list still lists it

services.name: Navajo Nation EMS (Shiprock)
services.area: Navajo Nation lands in San Juan County
services.evidence: "Navajo EMS is a dedicated and progressive service with a focus on quality care. Expanded life-support capabilities and transport service are pre-eminent." | NM 911 Program (DFA) EMS boundary layer assigns Navajo Nation lands in San Juan County to Agency_ID "ems.na-navajo.911-sanjuan.nm.us" (43% of the county). NM DOH EMS Bureau list, provided by the EMS Bureau 2026-10-21: 2025 list "Navajo Nation EMS- Shiprock | Certified Medical Rescue (Transport Capable) | ALS | Shiprock | Tribal | 4 vehicles"; 2026 first-responder list "Navajo Nation EMS- Shiprock".

35045.page_note: San Juan Regional Medical Center EMS runs the 911 ambulances for San Juan County, with ambulances stationed across the county. Navajo Nation EMS (Shiprock) also answers 911 and transports on Navajo Nation lands in the county. AIT Ambulance in Farmington is licensed for specialty-care and transfer transport.
35045.second_source: NM DOH EMS Bureau 2026-06-18 first-responder list (San Juan Regional EMS, Navajo Nation EMS- Shiprock); ImageTrend licence record: San Juan Regional EMS "911 Response (Scene) with Transport Capability"; AIT Ambulance "Specialty Care Transport"

35041.page_note: Eight local ambulance services split Roosevelt County by area: Portales Fire Department (Portales), Elida, Milnesand, Dora, Floyd, Causey, Arch, and Melrose Fire and Ambulance for the northwest corner. The Melrose Air Force Range in the county has no public 911 service area.
35041.second_source: ImageTrend licence records for all eight list "911 Response (Scene) with Transport Capability"; the remaining 4% of the county is the Cannon AFB boundary (Melrose Air Force Range)

35023.page_note: Hidalgo County EMS in Lordsburg and the county's volunteer ambulance services in Playas, Animas and Cotton City answer 911 and transport across Hidalgo County. The county says its EMS system has four volunteer departments, but only three volunteer ambulance services (Playas, Animas and Cotton City) could be named, so the fourth is not yet confirmed.
35023.second_source: ImageTrend licence records: these four are the only transport licences based in Hidalgo County
